Fourteen pinned third-party package paths passed valid local MP3 controls with ID3v2.3 or ID3v2.4 tags; six more are needed for the 20-path goal. The Laravel, Kiwilan, IndieHD, and Sempia paths share getID3; MediaFile shares Mp3Info; ID3Parser derives from getID3; debach and vollbehr share PHP Reader lineage; MetaAudio has its own ID3 module; the mhor and Pyrex wrappers delegate to MediaInfoLib; PHPVideoToolkit delegates to FFmpeg. Eight plausible leads remain unresolved, including legacy PHP incompatibility, an old Symfony dependency blocked by Composer, and a Laravel wrapper requiring an unprovided framework runtime. Not all 128 hits were inspected, so no definitive most-used top fourteen is asserted. The controls establish short or 18-second tagged MP3s, not every MP3 or tag variant.
